title: every post shows a picture, and every Page can have a Page picture

criteria.text: Every Page, of every kind, may set one optional Page picture: same field, flow and copy for every kind; a Page without one publishes and shows as today
criteria.note: `groups.picture_url`; `group.update` and `update_draft` take `pictureUrl`; a 'Page picture' picker beside Photo in the Page editor for both kinds [V]. Checked: [guards F099.1] in `PageEditor.test.tsx`, `update.test.ts`, `update-draft.test.ts`. Reviewed: #502 `Reviewed by:`. Smoked: `page-edit` opens green (10-21 to 10-23), but the picker needs a tap, which the read-only smoke does not do.

criteria.text: A Page with no Page picture shows its kind's placeholder image, identical on every load, to every viewer
criteria.note: `DefaultArt` by kind on the Page and the post card; since #969 (10-19) the signed-out withheld card draws it too when the Page has no photo [V]. Checked: no `[guards F099.2]` marker (#632); F082.8's guard (#908) asserts the kind's default art on a photoless Page's Explore card as a side effect. Smoked: `page` and `explore` green on 10-21 to 10-23, after the last merge, a load check only.

criteria.text: A post may carry one photo of its own; the composer completes without one; a second is refused
criteria.note: `page_posts.photo_url`, one URL in `group.post_create` and `post_edit`, never a list [V]. Checked: [guards F099.3] in `post.test.ts` (second refused), `PagePosts.test.tsx`, `tests/migrations-post-photos.test.ts`. Reviewed: #498 and #502. Smoked: the composer is not opened by smoke-live.

criteria.text: A post's photo belongs to that post only; it does not appear on the Page as a Page photo
criteria.note: Create and edit write `page_posts` only; `resolvePagePosts` selects no `groups` column [V]. Checked: [guards F099.4] in `post.test.ts` (no `groups` update on create) and `page-posts.test.ts`; the edit path is not asserted, though the handler reads clean.

criteria.text: The Page picture and a post photo use the existing upload path: WebP only, metadata stripped, the uploader's own folder, 5 MB at most, verified against the stored bytes
criteria.note: `isOwnMediaUrl` on both; the WebP, 5 MB and byte checks come from the reused F070 `PagePhotoPicker` path [A, not re-read]. Checked: [guards F099.5] in `post.test.ts`, `update.test.ts`, `update-draft.test.ts` (own folder; the rest is F070's).

criteria.text: Every post card shows exactly one image on its Page, in browse and on Home: the post's visible photo, else the Page's visible Page picture, else the kind placeholder
criteria.note: `browse_feed` resolves `photo_url` and `photo_source` in SQL; Page posts and `BrowseResultCard` fall to `DefaultArt` [V]. Since 10-16: #931 (#922 B) made the post card text-led with the one image as an 80px thumbnail, `Reviewed by:` and the F099.6 checks still pass; #983, #989 and #992 (review-skipped, image `src` and `loading` attributes only) serve card-sized WebP at 1x and 2x, the same image. Checked: [guards F099.6] in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` (three cases), `BrowseResultCard.test.tsx`, `PagePosts.test.tsx`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 0ebfaa1, 4d4417e, 0455ca2, 3753fd2. Smoked: `explore` and `page` green on 10-23 after every merge; `root` (Home) was last opened green on 10-19, before the sizing PRs; a load check only.

criteria.text: Visible means neither hidden nor removed, resolved in SQL, so a hidden or removed URL does not reach the browser and the card falls to the next image
criteria.note: `browse_feed` takes the post photo or Page picture only when its hidden and removed stamps are null; `resolvePagePosts` nulls the URL [V]. Checked: [guards F099.7] in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` (hidden or removed post photo never leaves the database; hidden Page picture and photo leave no URL) and `page-posts.test.ts`. #633's title still names 7, which is guarded; 11a remains.

criteria.text: The Page picture and each post photo are reportable on their own; a report hides that one image only, and the poster's notice names which
criteria.note: `reports.subject_kind` widened to `page_picture` and `post_photo`; `report.create`, `decide` and `reverse`; `HiddenPhotoNotice which=` [V]. #938 (10-19, `Reviewed by:`) labelled the entries: 'Report this Page's photo', 'Report this photo'. Checked: [guards F099.8] in `report/create.test.ts`, `review.test.ts`, `report-actions.test.ts`, `ReportControl.test.tsx`, `HiddenPhotoNotice.test.tsx`, `ReportEntry.test.tsx`, `PagePosts.test.tsx`, `page-posts.test.ts`, `review-subjects.test.ts`. Reviewed: #502 and #938 yes, but #501 (the report-decision fix) is `review-skipped`. Shipped: 647eccb green. The report sheet is opened by smoke-live on a business Page (`report-sheet`), last on 10-19, before #938.

criteria.text: Adding either image shows the sensitive-content ask at the moment of upload
criteria.note: Both pickers are `PagePhotoPicker` with the F080 ask [V]. Checked: the only marker, [guards F099.9] in `PagePosts.test.tsx`, covers the post photo; `PagePhotoPicker.test.tsx` asserts the ask unmarked, and nothing marked covers the Page picture (#632).

criteria.text: Every rendered image has alt text: Page picture and placeholder, the Page's name; post photo, the owner's words, else the default from title, date and place
criteria.note: Page picture alt is the Page name; a post photo's alt on the Page is the first line of the post (read as 'the owner's words' [A]); Explore cards fall back to `cardImageAlt` [V PagePosts.tsx, BrowseResultCard.tsx]. #931 kept the F099.10 checks passing on the restyled card. Checked: [guards F099.10] in `BrowseResultCard.test.tsx` and `PagePosts.test.tsx`. Smoked: `page` and `explore` green on 10-23, a load check only.

criteria.text: Signed out (F093), no post photo is in any response
criteria.note: `browse_feed` returns no post rows when `auth.uid()` is null; `announcements_withheld` carries no post column (its allow-list test gained `kind` in #969, still no post photo); `page_posts_select_published` refuses anon [V migrations 20261019143000]. Built by F093 #218 (no `Reviewed by:`) and #502. No test asserts it for post photos by name (#633).

criteria.text: The Page picture or placeholder shows wherever the Page's name does, and the withheld card is unchanged
criteria.note: The signed-out withheld card draws the Page's `photo_url` (the Page photo), and since #969 (change #335, merged 10-19) its kind's default art when there is none; it never draws `picture_url`, the Page picture [V withheld-announcements.ts, migration 20261019143000]. The criterion asks for the Page picture wherever the name shows and also for that card to stay unchanged (criterion 13 keeps the Page photo where it shows today); #335 is closed, and the picture-or-photo question on that card is still unruled. Routed to `scope-scenario`.

criteria.text: Removing either image records an event, and it stops showing on every surface on the next load
criteria.note: `group.update` event payload `fields:['picture_url']`; `group.post_edited` with `photo:'removed'` [V]. Checked: [guards F099.12] in `update.test.ts` and `post.test.ts`.

criteria.text: A Page's current photo stays its photo, shown where it shows today; the Page picture starts empty, so the placeholder shows on its posts until the owner sets one
criteria.note: `photo_url` is untouched; `picture_url` is a new nullable column, null by default [V migration 20261007290000]. Checked: [guards F099.13] in `PageEditor.test.tsx`.
